logline: Inside the opulent Ashbury estate, the treacherous Rupert and Catherine plot to seize the ducal title as the Dowager Duchess slowly withers, while in an icy barn, Juliana defiantly prepares remedies to save the fever-stricken villagers.

candidates.hook_text: Or has your sudden climb to power sweetened your taste already?
candidates.cliffhanger_text: Her shadow still hangs over this house.
candidates.rationale: High-impact opening confrontation immediately establishes the emotional stakes with no prior context required.
candidates.judge_rationale: Strong opening hook, intense cliffhanger, and crystal-clear melodrama dynamics.

candidates.hook_text: How much longer can the frail thing survive?
candidates.cliffhanger_text: Your palms are still raw from the fire. You shouldn't be working in this freezing draft.
candidates.rationale: Pivotal dramatic shift where a public insult turns into an explosive confrontation.
candidates.judge_rationale: Strong opening hook, intense cliffhanger, and crystal-clear melodrama dynamics.

candidates.hook_text: The chapel is gone, Seamus. I am the only healer these people have left.
candidates.cliffhanger_text: This house will only bow to me.
candidates.rationale: Episode climax building directly to the final unresolved revelation before cut to black.
candidates.judge_rationale: Strong opening hook, intense cliffhanger, and crystal-clear melodrama dynamics.
